title: QA run · surface:mixed (86/86) · 316be321 · 2026-10-04 · 57 PASS / 5 PARTIAL / 24 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
17.7 pre-release verification, mixed half: every runnable `surface:mixed` item (API truth plus a console surface) against `origin/main` as it stood when the browser run started, with the Console built from the bumped pin (#21710). 17.7 is not cut yet; packages still read 17.6.0. The non-browser half is #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`); the `surface:browser` record for this same subject is #21782. Text only: screenshots were consulted live as oracles and are not attached. The durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework (subject):** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` **`316be321`** (`fix(runtime)!: an app-authored body may not read the stored-metadata tables; it reaches them through the metadata API only (#21594) (#21660)`), in a dedicated detached worktree; framework and console built, smoke boot health 200 / `/_console` 200. #21743 (object-schema mask references) merged after this subject and is not in it.
- **Console:** built from objectui pin **`2e818d0b51ec`** (`.objectui-sha`, #21710); every lane checked the dist stamp against the pin. Console source questions were read at that revision. For the "predates 17.6.0" notes the references are framework `617f25f8a` (17.6.0) and objectui pin `31971ff1e`.
- **Checklist:** items, `RUNNER.md` and `scripts/checklist-select.mjs` from the subject tree; every item's revision is in the table and matches `areas/*.json`.
- **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase`, `OS_PORT={p} objectstack dev [--ui] --seed-admin -p {p} -d file:/tmp/qa1770fe/{lane}/{item}.db`, one file DB per item, per-lane port ranges 44701–45709 (egress proxy port 41333 excluded). Browser: Playwright on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. Members minted by admin `invite-member` + `sign-up/email` (plus `accept-invitation` where an org-admin grade was needed) or `admin/create-user`; identity proved with `GET /auth/get-session` before each persona cell. Scratch fixtures were authored at runtime in the item's own DB or in a scratch copy of the showcase under `/tmp` (capability declarations, wall-posture boots, job / connector probes); nothing was written into the subject tree.
- **Deviations, stated:**
  - **Rate-limit re-run.** Lanes FE15 and FE16 and verifier VF3 were interrupted once by an API rate limit (~18:06Z) and re-run from scratch on fresh DBs (`r2`) from 23:57Z. Only the re-runs count; the partial first outputs were discarded.
  - **Midnight crossing.** The FE15 and FE16 re-runs crossed UTC midnight; every date-window and retention expectation was derived from one recorded instant (lifecycle clock 2026-10-05T00:39:33Z; FE16 windows computed against 2026-10-05).
  - **Non-default boots, per item:** `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true` (time-relative, trigger-type schedule leg, job-scheduled-run, notification-center), `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info` (hook lines, lifecycle sweep), `NODE_ENV=production` for the no-SMS phone-OTP variant, `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE=open` for email verification, walled tenancy postures from a scratch copy. One 17.6.0 control boot (scratch DB) classified the field-reorder defect as pre-existing.
  - **Extra repro boots.** FE7 and FE12 re-reproduced their fails on second fresh-boot DBs. One FE13 boot shifted 45304 → 45305 (in range).
- **Execution:** ten parallel runner subagents (FE7–FE16) and independent verifiers VF1–VF5 (RUNNER rule 7), Claude Code session `session_018zT8d8NpiQ1ExhuNd5TxY6`, 2026-10-04 15:32Z – 2026-10-05 ~00:45Z. Concurrency was capped at three lanes (maintainer order), verifiers counted as lanes. Tier-1 pins that live in this repository were run first and are cited in the table; items whose `automated.ref` lives only in objectui were driven by hand.

## Scope

Hidden as blocked (not run): `identity-auth.linked-accounts-social`, `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel`. Two **planned** items matched and are recorded as `planned` (not driven, not in the title's counts): `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` (rev 1), `records-forms.picklist-org-append` (rev 1).

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

### Product defects

**access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop A2** {m05} — the console cannot save a permission set an admin is entitled to edit (fails closed).
- (1) `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.fe7.perm2","name":"P2","version":"0.1.0","type":"app"}}` → 201; `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/perm2_c6?package=com.fe7.perm2 {"name":"perm2_c6","label":"x","objects":{"showcase_task":{"allowRead":true}}}` → 200 twice; `GET /api/v1/meta/permission`; repeat the PUT → **403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "… declared by package 'com.fe7.perm2' and is locked"** (draft PUTs too). Any Studio page load issues that list read, so a Studio visit locks every set in the package.
- (2) `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set {name:'fe7_orgset2',…}`; `GET /meta/permission/fe7_orgset2?layers=true` serves the env projection as the `code` layer with no provenance; `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/permission/fe7_orgset2` shows "Locked: a code package provides this permission set" while the server says `editable:true` and a plain PUT answers 200. The same lock reaches a "Clone to customize" clone.
- **Root cause (VF2):** the list read hydrates the overlay with `_packageId` (`protocol.ts:9223`, `:17108`, `:8819`) and `declaredPackageIdOf` (`packaged-permission-set-lock.ts:150-161`) ignores the row's org provenance; the projection echo is served as the code layer (`permission-set-projection.ts:737-741`, `protocol.ts:10036-10049`), which objectui `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:174-183` reads as artifact-backed.
- **Predates 17.6.0.** Verifier VF2: CONFIRMED, P2. Related, not the same: #21761.

**access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle A6** {m06} — Setup → Permission Sets → Showcase Contributor → Edit → change Description → Update: `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set/{id}` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "… Clone it instead (the "Clone" action …)" with no `userMessage`; banner and toast read "You don't have permission to save this record." Expected: the clone-path sentence.
- **Root cause (VF3):** `PackagedPermissionSetLockedError` (`plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.ts:269-287`) declares no `userMessage`, so objectui `form.tsx:2540-2545` substitutes its generic text by design (#3821). Same class as closed #19397.
- **Predates 17.6.0.** Verifier VF3: CONFIRMED (API + UI, twice), P3.

**identity-auth.auth-method-matrix A4** {m03} — boot `NODE_ENV=production OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true` with no SMS provider; `POST /api/v1/auth/phone-number/send-otp {"phoneNumber":"+15551230002"}`. Expected a 4xx naming `NOT_SUPPORTED`; actual **500, empty body** (the code appears only in the log). `/auth/config` correctly withholds `phoneNumberOtp`.
